title: Global prevalence and burden of depressive and anxiety disorders in 204 countries and territories in 2020 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

minorUnsupportedClaims: Pre-pandemic prevalence incorrectly attributed to GBD 2019; the source used GBD 2020 estimates from DisMod-MR 2.1 without COVID-19 data.
model.rationale: The generated text faithfully reproduces the design, sample, methods, effect estimates, and conclusions from the reference. The only minor discrepancy is the misattribution of pre-pandemic prevalence to GBD 2019 rather than the 2020 pre-COVID estimates from the same modelling framework. No fabricated endpoints or unsupported major claims are present.
